worker.description: Implementation role. Dispatched by mmw-implement, one ticket per worker, in a given worktree. Follow mmw-tdd and commit; leave docs/ as they are; do not push; do not expand the ticket.

worker-high-risk.description: High-risk implementation role. Dispatched by mmw-implement for billing, permissions, data migration, or irreversible mistakes. Follow mmw-tdd and commit; leave docs/ as they are; do not push; do not expand the ticket.

planner.description: Planner role. Dispatched by mmw-to-plan, one planner and one plan per ticket. Follow mmw-planner; write only that plan; do not edit source.

advisor.description: Second-opinion advisor running the stronger model. Consult at commitment boundaries — before architectural decisions, data migrations, big refactors, or API designs, and whenever the same problem has resisted two attempts — and before you treat an interpretation as settled. Pass the last user/assistant text turns, your current understanding, the constraints, and the options considered. Do not pass the session or its tool trace. Returns a verdict with reasoning and the risk that decides it. Advises only — never implements.

designer.description: Read-only interface designer. Dispatched by Design It Twice, one design per constraint. Return the interface, usage, and trade-offs. Do not modify files.

reviewer-gpt.description: Isolated in-session reviewer (GPT side), read-only. Dispatched by mmw-review: one perspective per reviewer, in parallel with others and with the Claude-side reviewer. Goal and materials come from the caller. Do not edit code, fix findings, or write spec or plan.

reviewer-claude.description: Isolated in-session reviewer (Claude side), read-only. Dispatched by mmw-review: one perspective per reviewer, in parallel with others and with the GPT-side reviewer. Goal and materials come from the caller. Do not edit code, fix findings, or write spec or plan.
